1945, October 20 1947. January 14
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ON A SERAPHIC MASS ASSOCIATION PLAQUE, THE FOLLOWING IS HANDWRITTEN BY FR. SOLANUS:
Mrs. Alice Flunkett for God's Holy Guidance - October 20> 1945
God bless you Mrs. Plunkett,
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap. Delegate
Thanks be to God Grandma! You've wethered acother storm ... Congratulations! Pray for all the rest of us, that we learn to love God's holy will.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
ON A GOLDEN JUBILEE REMEMBRANCE CARD, THE FOLLOWING IS HANDWRITTEN BY FR. SOLANUS:
Jan. 14
God bless you Mrs. Plunkett
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.C
ON A SERAPHIC MASS ASSOCIATION CARD, THE FOLLOWING IS HANDWRITTEN BY FR. SOLANUS:
God bless Grandma Plunkett and all her helpers and friends.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Original in possession of: Miss Esther Plunkett 20505 Charleston Detroit, Michigan 48203
